timeline.text: Supper in the parlour; Colette serves and clears.
Julian Ashcombe arrives and repairs with Edmund to the study.
Raised voices behind the study door -- the argument over the sold sketches.
Julian leaves by the front door. The ledger has it: 'gone quarter past ten.'
Edmund telephones someone for a few minutes. 'Come tonight. Bring nothing.'
Colette sets the morning's bread; kitchen door shut, wireless on.
Peggy comes down for her sewing scissors -- she was in the parlour after ten.
Lightning cuts the power; the hall clock stops. The house scatters for candles.
Colette lights the pantry lantern and bakes on in the dark; Peggy carries her candle up.
Power returns; the hall clock restarts, twenty-one minutes blind. The kitchen wireless sings again to nobody.
The kitchen-garden door stands off its bolt. Someone used it in the dark.
The mantel clock falls and stops. Edmund staggers.
Edmund Vesper dies in the wing chair.
Colette brings the tea tray and finds him cold.
